title: LineFeature
description: FROZEN at 0:15. One GeoJSON Feature per rail line in GET /lines.geojson. geometry is LineString or MultiLineString in [lon,lat] order (GeoJSON spec).

lineId.description: Internal key from contracts/lines.csv. Join key for everything.

status.description: unknown => render grey. Lines with no live status feed are 'unknown', never faked 'normal'.

statusText.description: Human text from the feed, or 'No live status feed' for unknown.

color.description: Official line livery colour; used when status=normal and as the search-highlight tint.
